translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: MATEO
book.title: Dos Moppiyon Dinoggan no id Sulat ni MATEO

content: Dos Mowwet to Langun diyon to Kodharit Monama
Na iddon timpu, id porani ki Disas iddos mgo tinodduwan din woy mid intud, kahi ran to, “Ondoy man kos mowwet to langun diyon to kodharit Monama?”
De-en id poporani ni Disas iddos sokkad no anak woy id poohinat din diyot tongannan dan.
Kahin rin to, “Bonnaavonnaa nod ikohiyon ku koniyu, no konna kow od kolonug diyon to kodharit Monama otik dii row od lommiyon kos poomdom dow woy otik dii kow od poobbava iling to anak.
Su iddos ahad ondoy nod poobbava to ko-ugolingun din iling ka-ay't anak, sikandin kos mowwet to langun diyon to kodharit Monama.
Woy dos ahad ondoy nod tanggap to mopoobbavon minuvu iling ka-ay't anak pomon to kopomakoy rin koddi, siyak kos id tanggap din.”
Dos Moka-atag to Minuvu nod Okoy to Duma riyot Kodpuung to Saa

“Na, iddos ahad ondoy nod poko-okoy nod puung to saa kos mopoobbavon minuvu iling ka-ay't disok no anak no od pomakoy koddi, moppiya pa nod ikottan kos liyog din to oray'n dakkoon gilingan no batu woy id lumbag diyot kinoroomman to dahat.

Moka-arat-arat kod kotomanan taddot mgo minuvu no unayan nod ko-okoy kos duma riyot kodpuung to saa. Od inguma en kos mgo kodgeddam, piru moka-arat-arat iddos silut taddot minuvu no noko-iling to daan tadda.

“De-en otik ikos bollad o pa-a ru kos unayan nod pokopuung ka to saa, tompoddowd baling ika woy lumbag du. Su moppiya pa nod pokotanggap ka to umuun waad tomanon no sokkad da kos bollad o pa-a, kuntra to duwon oruwon bollad o pa-a ru no id lumbag ka riyon to linow't apuy no konna od ko-ovukkan.

Woy otik ikos mata ru kos unayan nod pokosaa ka, kootowd baling ika woy lumbag du. Oyyos moppiya pa nod pokotanggap ka to umuun waad tomanon no sokkad da kos mata, kuntra to duwon oruwon mata ru no id lumbag ka riyon to linow't apuy.”
Dos Ponunggelengan Moka-atag to Karnero no Notarin

“Ayyad-ayyad kow no konna kow od lommot to ahad sokkad nod poobbava iling ka-ay't moollimot poron no mgo anak. Oyyos od ikohiyan ku sikiyu, no iddos mgo ponolihan no id tavang kandan, inaayun duma to Amoy ku no riyot datas to langit.
[Su siyak no Anak to Minuvu, mid undini to ingod amoy'd nangkap to mgo minuvu no moriyu to Monama woy od tobbus kandan.]

“Diyot koniyu, ondan ayu kos od puungan to minuvu otik duwon mahatus no karnero, woy od kotorinan idda to sokkad? Id tuwos din en iddos siyowmpuu-siyow riyot posobsavan amoy od nongkapon din iddos sokkad no notarin.
To nokita rin don idda, bonnaavonnaa nod ikohiyon ku koniyu, no lampas pa kos kahaan din taddot sokkad no karnero kuntra taddot siyowmpuu-siyow no waa notarin.
Na, ungketen dad en mandad kos Amoy row no riyot datas to langit. Konna sikandin od kopiyan nod kotarin kos ahad sokkad da to mgo sakup din iling ka-ay't moollimot poron no mgo anak.”
Dos Kodtavang diyot Suwod to Kopomakoy no Nokopuung to Saa

“Otik duwon suwod du riyot kopomakoy no nokosaa kikow, undiyonniyu sikandin woy ponudtuu ru iddos saa rin kikow no siksikoniyu ra. Otid pominog sikandin woy od tonggapon din kos osengan du, na nokod-uli ron kos songnga rin kikow.
Piru otik dii en sikandin od pominog, piyod ka to sokkad o oruwon minuvu amoy duwon od posivonnaa koniyu.

Na, otik dii pe-en sikandin od pominog kandan, posaddoo ru idda riyon tod lolivuung nod pompomakoy. Woy otik dii en sikandin od pominog taddot id pomandu tod pompomakoy, po-iling dud sikandin to sokkad no minuvu no waa Monama o oray'd loimbung no tohodsukut to buhis.”

“Od ikohiyan ku sikiyu, no iddos ahad ondan nod diiyan dow ka-ay to ampow't ingod, od diiyan mandad idda riyot datas to langit. Woy dos ahad ondan nod omanan dow ka-ay to ampow't ingod, od omanan mandad idda riyot datas to langit.
“Od ikohiyan ku mandad sikiyu, no otik duwon oruwa no nokodsokkad to ahad ondan nod buyuwon dan diyot Monama, id boggoy en idda to Amoy ku no riyot datas to langit.
Su ahad oruwa o otollu kos od lolivuung pomon to kopomakoy ran koddi, diyon a mandad duma kandan.”
Dos Ponunggelengan Moka-atag to Sudsuhuwon no Diid Posinsya
Na, id undiyon si Pedro to ki Disas woy mid intud, kahi rin to, “Longaggon, kopila ku od posinsyan kos suwod ku no nokopuung to saa koddi? Ko-pittu vo?”
Mid tavak si Disas to, “Konna ra kopittu, ko konna, kopittumpuu pittu.
Su iddos kodharit Monama, od poko-iling ka-ay'n ponunggelengan. Duwon hari nod sosukut to utang diyot mgo sudsuhuwon din.
To id tigkanoy pa sikandin id sosukut, duwon sokkad no sudsuhuwon no id piyod diyot kandin no noko-utang to maanmaan
no soopi.

Na pomon to waa id pokovayad din, id suhu taddot hari no id boligya iddon sudsuhuwon amoy'd uriponnon, apii iddos sawa woy mgo anak din. Woy id suhu mandad taddot hari no id povoligya kos langun no koruwonnan din amoy id bayad to utang.
Pomon tadda, mid lingko-od iddos sudsuhuwon woy id po-eru-eru riyot hari, kahi rin to, ‘Sir, boggayi a pa to timpu, su od boyaran ku en sikkow taddot langun no utang ku.’
Na no-eruwan iddos hari, de-en id posinsyan din sikandin woy id podwora rin don iddos utang din woy id po-uli.

“To mid leggua ron iddon sudsuhuwon, nosinuggung din iddos duma rin no sudsuhuwon no duwon mandad utang kandin, piru disok da. Idda ron en, id pokkoo rin iddos noko-utang kandin woy kahi rin to, ‘Boyariyud en iddos utang du koddi!’
Na iddos duma rin no sudsuhuwon, mid lingko-od woy id po-eru-eru kandin, kahi rin to, ‘Boggayi a pa to timpu, su od boyaran ku en sikkow.’
Piru waa en sikandin id aman woy id poprisu rin da en baling taman tod kovoyaran din iddos utang.
To nokita to dumon mgo sudsuhuwon iddon notomanan, oraroy ran no nosokitan. Woy mid undiyon sikandan to hari woy id ponudtuu ran iddos langun no notomanan.
“De-en id po-umow taddot hari iddon sudsuhuwon, kahi rin to, ‘Oray'n morat kos botasan du! Id posinsyan ku sikkow taddot langun no utang du, su id po-eru-eru ka koddi.
Mambo moho to waa eru ru riyot duma ru no sudsuhuwon iling taddot id pokita ku kikow?’
Pomon to lingasa taddot hari, id suhu rin nod prisuwon woy'd posokitan iddon sudsuhuwon taman tod pokovayad taddot langun no utang din.”
Na mid ikahi si Disas to, “Ungketen dad en mandad kos od puungan koniyu to Amoy ku no riyot datas to langit, otik dii row od posinsyan to bonnaavonnaa iddos nokopuung to saa koniyu.”

footnotes.text: Dos utang taddot sokkad no sudsuhuwon, oray'n dakkoo. Dos kontidad to utang din, annom no maan (6,000) no denario, no iddos kohulugan, ollog no id bayad to sokkad no minuvu nod urunaa daom to sopuu-annom no lahun.
